text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan and Bahrain discuss setting a joint Bahraini-Jordanian Bank to ease trade between the two countries.
- Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali says Jordan's ties with Syria are normal despite some differences in views.
- Crown Prince Hassan stresses the support of Jordan of the right of return of Palestinian refugees. AL ARAB AL YAWM
- Austria supports setting up a European fund to aid Jordan.
- Second Jordanian arrested for posting anti-Israeli signs.
